contractBundle: unreleased-candidate; pin exact signed bundle before D2

scenarios.stimulus: submit the public synthetic matrix workload to an approved idle lab provider
scenarios.expected: one policy-approved classification, offer, placement, fenced lease, bounded worker execution, trusted receipt, evidence object and test-credit settlement

scenarios.stimulus: submit without an authenticated institution/project binding
reference an object outside the requester's approved purpose
scenarios.expected: fail closed without exposing object existence or content

scenarios.stimulus: deny the submitted workload class or allow only a lower-trust provider

scenarios.expected: retryable unavailability and no implicit allow

scenarios.stimulus: retry an identical authorized submit after its response is lost
scenarios.expected: same workload and one effective outbox event

scenarios.stimulus: reuse an idempotency key with a different canonical request
publish a stale or revoked low-price provider capability
lower an ineligible provider's price below every approved offer
scenarios.expected: winner remains inside the hard-eligible set

scenarios.stimulus: replay a stale generation or activation challenge
scenarios.expected: fenced rejection without extra execution time

scenarios.stimulus: cancel while offer acceptance and worker activation race
scenarios.expected: one terminal decision and no post-cancel work

scenarios.stimulus: reclaim desktop capacity while a synthetic task runs
scenarios.expected: bounded drain or safe stop under the owner-reclaim policy

scenarios.stimulus: disconnect or lose the worker mid-attempt
scenarios.expected: lease fail-stop, bounded retry and no duplicate effective result

scenarios.stimulus: publish overlapping or duplicate usage intervals
scenarios.expected: one accepted interval and conflict/dispute for the rest

scenarios.stimulus: tamper with a receipt digest or provider-supplied termination reason
scenarios.expected: tamper rejection or held disputed incident pending authority adjudication

scenarios.stimulus: make the ledger unavailable after operational completion
scenarios.expected: durable pending batch; no loss or double settlement on retry

scenarios.stimulus: rebuild a projector from retained canonical evidence
restore operational state and roll back an incompatible controller release
scenarios.expected: previous supported version resumes with no weaker policy or lost accepted request
